summary: Learn journey mapping, service blueprinting and prototype testing for cross-channel services. Explore the course and practical curriculum.
lede: Service design and journey redesign help teams improve end-to-end services across digital and assisted channels. For CX teams, public service leaders, digital service managers and process improvement specialists, the work includes mapping user journeys, tracing frontstage and backstage handoffs, prioritizing service friction, and testing low-fidelity prototypes. It also covers accessibility checks, feedback analysis and measures for service improvement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, operate, assess or improve services across customer and citizen-facing channels.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with a customer-facing, citizen-facing or internal service process is expected. No coding is required. Bring a laptop for exercises using familiar office software; specialist software access is not required to complete the core activities.
